Variants.Content: House Siwen rules the southeastern part of the Stormlands from Stonehelm, and its coast, border roads, and vast vassal network give it long-term weight.

The Siwen family is based on Stonehelm City, and its territory faces the Dorne Sea and the southeastern road of the Stormlands. Coastal castles must guard against pirates, border conflicts, and levies from the interior at the same time, so the weight of history comes from stone walls, ships, knights, and judgments of wind direction. Old feuds on the Dornish borders make every marriage pact and caravan pass with extra caution.

Sailors use Stonehelm as a sea route marker, frontier soldiers use it as a post to observe the mountain passes and the sea, and Dornish merchants are concerned about whether the city gates are willing to open according to regulations. If Sven can let all three types of people know who to negotiate with, the castle will be more valuable than a simple stone.
